text:
sam_sales: Heads up — Sigma POC hit a hard block on rerank endpoint. Client sends encoder embeddings, endpoint returns 400 "dims mismatch". They expected 768 but payload has 1536. Anyone seen this during encoding changeover?

raj_eng_oncall: Can you paste the failing request body (sanitized) + model names? Also which endpoint — /v1/embeddings or our rerank endpoint?

sam_sales: FWIW here's redacted snippet they sent:
```json
{"model":"sigma/encoder-v2","input":["doc1","doc2"],"batch_size":2}
```
API reply:
```
400 Bad Request
{"error":"embedding dims mismatch: expected 768 for model 'rerank-a', got 1536"}
```
They say their client library bundles query+doc embeddings — maybe double-concatenated.

lia_ml: Two quick possibilities:
- They switched encoder model to a larger variant (1536d) while rerank service is pinned to 768d.
- Their client is concatenating vectors (query+doc) before sending, so vector length doubles.
Check their model strings and whether we autoswapped to `encoder-v2-large`.

julia_support: @sam_sales I asked for the full request id and we pulled traces: trace id `tr-0a1b2c`. Logs show incoming `model: encoder-v2-large` at 15:22:11 UTC.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: rolled back recent encoder alias update at 15:24:03 UTC (change id deploy-559).

raj_eng_oncall: OK that matches. Two remediation paths:
1) Have Sigma request embeddings from a 768d encoder (model `encoder-v2`), or
2) Update rerank config to accept 1536d variant (requires a quick validation + small config rollout).
Which is better for the POC? Also, we can temporarily accept 1536d for their org id `org-sigma` for POC.

sam_sales: They prefer not to change rerank config. Can we do the temporary accept? Also they're asking about pricing impact for larger dims.

mike_secd: Quick note on security Q: Sigma asked if embeddings are stored; default POC retention is 7 days. Confirmed that's in the docs and we can toggle for enterprise. I've sent the security questionnaire update.

lia_ml: For temporary path I can update rerank mapping to accept 1536 and run a quick smoke test. Will need 15–20m. If we do that, their end-to-end will work without client changes.

raj_eng_oncall: I'll open a short-lived feature flag for `org-sigma` to bypass dim-check and route to the 1536-capable rerank shard. Also increased per-org rate limit to 60 rps while they run tests.

sam_sales: Thanks — pinging Sigma. They ran a quick test and now see 200 with embeddings shape [2,1536]. Can we validate scores look sane?

lia_ml: Running small eval on their test set now. Initial results look reasonable; rerank score distribution comparable to our baseline. No obvious regressions.

sam_sales: Customer confirms POC unblocked. They're asking for note on permanent path and cost delta for 1536d.

julia_support: I'll draft a short note: 1536d increases per-embedding compute and storage ~2x vs 768d. For POC we can keep the temporary acceptance, but recommend they pick one model for production. I'll add a pricing estimate and send to sales.

sam_sales: Great. Closing this swarm — thanks all :tada:

raj_eng_oncall: Leaving a short follow-up task: create a rollout checklist to avoid accidental alias swaps. Filed task DEVOPS-1198.

mike_secd: I'll attach the updated security question answers in the deal thread.

sam_sales: Awesome, closing. If anything else pops up, reopen.
